Callout.Name: Ejection from a Club
Callout.Message: Person refusing to leave a nightclub.
Callout.Advisory: Door staff holding him at the entrance.

Script.Line: I paid to get in and I am not leaving.
The bouncer put his hands on me first.
One drink. I have had one drink and they threw me out.

Lines.Approach: The door staff have him outside and he will not walk away. He is not armed, he is just determined.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
